The failure output did expose the underlying rate-limit error and a retry command, which is actionable, but it did not preserve the useful investigation as a clear human-facing summary or produce a verified fix; the hidden test then failed. Carry forward the already identified location and next-step plan when recovering from transient provider failures, and make transient rate-limit recovery bounded and explicit so users are not sent through another full investigation.

The investigation included some redundant searches and a broad read of completions_test.go; starting from the append-with-terminator call found by its initial exact search would tighten context further. Its progress and final summary clearly explained the change and verification.
